segments.name: Multifamily
segments.description: Develops and holds residential rental communities within master-planned projects, beginning with Terra Vista at Tejon.
segments.evidence: In connection with the commencement of lease-up at Terra Vista at Tejon, we began reporting Multifamily as a separate operating segment in 2025, reflecting our expansion into the development and long-term ownership of residential rental communities.

segments.name: Real estate - resort/residential
segments.description: Holds and entitles land for large-scale master-planned resort and residential communities; not a revenue-generating segment.
segments.evidence: Note: Our Resort Residential reporting segment is not a revenue generating segment in the periods reported herein.

segments.name: Mineral resources
segments.description: Generates recurring royalty income from third-party extraction activities on company landholdings.
segments.evidence: Our mineral resources operations generate recurring royalty income from third-party extraction activities with minimal capital deployment by the Company.

segments.name: Farming
segments.description: Grows almonds and pistachios on the San Joaquin Valley floor as an interim productive use of land.
segments.evidence: Our almond and pistachio acreage located on the San Joaquin Valley floor generates current cash flow and maintains these properties in active agricultural production pending potential future development, including areas contemplated for projects such as Grapevine North.

segments.name: Ranch operations
segments.description: Supports land stewardship, infrastructure maintenance and cost management across the company's landholdings.
segments.evidence: Our ranch operations primarily support land stewardship and cost management across our broader landholdings.

revenueModel.text: The company earns lease and land-sale revenue from commercial and industrial tenants, rental income from multifamily apartments, royalties from third-party mineral extraction, and farming sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Our mineral resources operations generate recurring royalty income from third-party extraction activities with minimal capital deployment by the Company.
